notes.title: Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! Thank you all so much for playing the game and hopfully things went well! I am currently adding gamepad support for the game and adding in acheivements/leaderboards as well. Also during the next update I will be adding trading cards and badges for the game as well, just looking to get the art finished up for them as we speak. There will also be some minor bug fixes and improvements to the AI as well as some easter eggs getting thrown in there. I am hoping to have this update out this week sometime and will be looking to add more content to the game in the near future! Thanks again everybody for the support on my first adventure through game releases! 

-Warka
